description: Single configuration record for the Salis Fleet Management module.

fields.description: Default company applied to Salis transactions when not set explicitly.
fields.label: Default Company

fields.description: Default cost center used for fleet cost postings.
fields.label: Default Cost Center

fields.description: Number of days before an expiry or due date to start raising alerts.
fields.label: Alert Lead Days

fields.description: Lead days for driver licence-expiry alerts; the effective window is the larger of this and Alert Lead Days.
fields.label: License Alert Lead Days

fields.description: Days to expiry at or below which a driver licence or vehicle compliance document is flagged 'expiring' (amber) in the driver portal; blank or zero uses the built-in default.
fields.label: License Expiring Warn Days

fields.description: Number of days without a dispatch trip before an Active vehicle is flagged as idle.
fields.label: Idle Vehicle Days

fields.description: Days a vehicle may remain in the workshop before a Maintenance Overdue alert is raised.
fields.label: Workshop Overstay Days

fields.description: Number of days a Fuel Request may stay Pending before it is flagged as overdue.
fields.label: Fuel Request Pending Max Days

fields.description: Percent a vehicle's actual fuel consumption may exceed its monthly quota before an overage / excessive-topup alert is raised; blank or zero uses the built-in default.
fields.label: Fuel Overage Margin (%)

fields.description: Hours an open Info alert may age before the queue flags it as overdue. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Info Alert Aging Hours

fields.description: Hours an open Warning alert may age before the queue flags it as overdue. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Warning Alert Aging Hours

fields.description: Hours an open Critical alert may age before the queue flags it as overdue. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Critical Alert Aging Hours

fields.description: Allow drivers to access the self-service portal.
fields.label: Enable Driver Portal

fields.description: Assumed average fleet speed (km/h) used to estimate the worker's live ride ETA from the driver's GPS position; blank or zero uses the built-in default.
fields.label: Assumed Fleet Speed (km/h)

fields.description: Maximum 'remaining passengers' notifications the driver may send a worker before that worker can be marked Absent at departure; blank or zero uses the default.
fields.label: Boarding Notify Max Count

fields.description: Seconds the worker has to respond after each driver notification (drives the client countdown). A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Boarding Notify Window (Seconds)

fields.description: Grace period (minutes) from trip start before notify escalation and absence marking apply. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Boarding Grace (Minutes)

fields.description: Minutes after a worker self-claims boarding before it is auto-confirmed (Boarded) when the driver neither confirms nor rejects; blank or zero uses the default.
fields.label: Boarding Auto-Confirm (Minutes)

fields.description: Maximum 'please wait' requests a worker may send the driver per trip. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Worker Wait Request Max

fields.description: Seconds a worker's 'please wait' request is held active (drives the client countdown). A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Worker Wait Request (Seconds)

fields.description: How often (seconds) the worker portal polls its boarding state during an active trip. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Boarding Active Poll (Seconds)

fields.description: Send background push notifications (trip assigned, fuel approved) to opted-in driver devices; needs the VAPID keys below plus pywebpush on the server, else a safe no-op.
fields.label: Enable Driver Web Push

fields.description: VAPID 'sub' claim — a mailto: or https: contact the push service can reach (e.g. mailto:ops@yourcompany.com).
fields.label: VAPID Subject

fields.description: VAPID public key (base64url). Handed to the browser to subscribe; safe to expose.
fields.label: VAPID Public Key

fields.description: VAPID private key. Secret — stored encrypted, never exposed to the client.
fields.label: VAPID Private Key

fields.description: Master switch to enable approval routing across Salis transactions.
fields.label: Enable Approvals

fields.description: Require approval when an assignment or transfer crosses project boundaries.
fields.label: Cross-Project Needs Approval

fields.description: Block vehicle assignment when the linked vehicle has expired compliance.
fields.label: Block Assignment On Expired Compliance

fields.description: Fuel requests above this litre amount require approval.
fields.label: Fuel Request Approval Threshold (L)

fields.description: Passenger counts above this number require Operations-tier authority.
fields.label: Passenger Count Operations Threshold

fields.description: Administrative / document-signing requests with more than this many trips this month require Operations-tier authority. A blank or zero value falls back to the built-in default.
fields.label: Administrative Trip Operations Threshold

fields.description: Vehicle Damage Write-Off cases at or above this estimated cost (SAR) require Operations-tier authority; lower-value cases require at least Regional-tier.
fields.label: Write-Off Operations Threshold (SAR)

fields.description: Movement Cost Recovery amounts at or above this value (SAR) require Operations-tier authority; lower amounts require at least Regional-tier.
fields.label: Cost Recovery Operations Threshold (SAR)

name: Salis Settings
